question: A can do a certain work in 15 days, while B can do the same work in 21 days. If they work together, then in how many days will the same work be completed?
solution:
**Given data:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 15 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 21 days

**Calculations:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1over 15

Work done by B in 1 day = 1over 21

Total work done by A and B in 1 day = 1over 15 + 1over 21 = 36over 21times 15

TIme taken to complete total work = 21times 15over 36 = 83over 4 days.

∴ **The total work was completed in 83over 4 days.**
